reason: The A/B report only comes with Growth, and the refund if there is no lift after 30 days makes testing it close to free for me. 49 EUR is nothing against my revenue, so I would pay for Growth to get the measurement.
objection: Will the script slow down my site or clash with my design? I would check Core Web Vitals before and after, and if the page speed or conversion drops I turn it off.
would_change_my_mind: A page speed hit I can measure, or an A/B report that I cannot trust or that does not segment by traffic source.
